reason: My first question is always whether it's really tested, and here the lab is named and the report is behind the QR code, so I can check it. $24.99 for the first box is an easy try on TikTok Shop, and I'd take it in the evening after the gym.
objection: Made in China. A report only covers the batch they tested, and I'd want to be sure the QR report really matches the box I get.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report didn't open or the batch number didn't match the box, I'd pass.
